page: Vercel AI cloud deployment: platform for building, scaling, securing applications. Hono deploys to Vercel with zero-configuration. Starter templates available via create-hono. Requires Vercel CLI for local development. Development server runs on localhost:3000. Deploy command: vercel deploy. Export app as default export from index.ts or src/index.ts.

sections.manifest: Project setup with create-hono@latest my-app selecting vercel template. Installation with npm/yarn/pnpm/bun (cd my-app, run install). Install Vercel CLI globally from official documentation.
Create Hono app in index.ts or src/index.ts as default export. GET / endpoint returns welcome text. If using vercel template, already configured.
Run development server locally: vercel dev. Access localhost:3000 for text response.
Deploy to Vercel: vercel deploy or vc deploy command.
Further reading: Vercel documentation for Hono framework integration.
